messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide launches autonomous ride-share service in Millfield. Price: $0.18 per mile. Average wait time: 15 minutes. Cove
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Active auto insurance policies in area: 23. Cancellations increasing.

Business closing: Jake Morrison — execute the under-$22k floor strategy with real discipline this month: pull every unit priced under $22k to the front of the lot, build a targeted pitch around total monthly cost (not sticker), and personally call five pre-qualified leads from the past 90 days who were shopping in that range but did not close. this is not outreach for the sake of activity — i am trying to close at least one unit before the end of the month to stop the savings bleed.

Business closing: James Patterson — complete the honda accord private sale: transfer title, receive $18,800 from buyer, deposit into savings. the multi-week negotiation process that began tick 1 closes here. simultaneously cancel auto insurance policy with priya since i no longer own a vehicle — this reduces monthly expenses by approximately $127/month.

Community action: Priya Sharma — one-on-one with linda park: give honest field intelligence. tell her the 25-policy number is a floor that will keep falling as roboride adoption accelerates. share my read that personal auto liability is being absorbed by corporate fleet coverage — our book of business isn't recoverable, it's structurally shrinking. don't soften it. also signal that i'm not waiting passively: mention the sql and data analysis coursework i've been doing, float the idea that there may be a role in commercial fleet risk analytics or insurtech that autoshield could pivot toward. ask her directly: what's the timeline she's working with, and what does she need from me to help navigate it.

You Participate in Linda Park's one-on-one meeting. Give her honest, specific field intelligence about customer cancellations — the real reasons clients are leaving: they sold their cars, switched to RoboRide, or couldn't justify the premium when they're barely driving. Frame it professionally as data, not despair. In exchange, probe Linda for what AutoShield's regional strategy is: are they pivoting to new product lines, are there internal transfers available, is there a corporate retraining program? Listen more than I talk. Take mental notes on whether she seems like she has a plan or whether she's just gathering data to manage upward.. Savings dropped by $1,938.
